First, we calculate $P(A)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\ \frac{5}{6} & =P(A)+\frac{2}{5}-\frac{1}{3} \\ P(A) & =\frac{5}{6}+\frac{1}{3}-\frac{2}{5} \\  & =\frac{25}{30}+\frac{10}{30}-\frac{12}{30} \\  & =\frac{23}{30}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region ${A}^{′}\cup {B}^{′}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041480/assets/4b5f335b449e5f07de1d9ac1590245e71f6825b2dc13fe4ba046985aac95465a.png)

Finally, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P({A}^{′}\cup {B}^{′}) & =\frac{13}{30}+\frac{1}{15}+\frac{1}{6} \\  & =\frac{13}{30}+\frac{2}{30}+\frac{5}{30} \\  & =\frac{2}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
